# Great Wall of Ideas

> Great Wall of Ideas (https://greatwallofideas.com) is a community product for sharing unfinished ideas, discovering what resonates, discussing the details, and branching an existing idea into a remix. It treats an idea as the beginning of a conversation, not a polished pitch that must already have every answer.

Tagline: "Publish the rough idea. Find the people who can make it better."

## How it works

1. Publish: write an idea with a rich-text editor, then choose a category and tags that make it discoverable. Ideas can be posted anonymously, and authors can keep an idea private.
2. Discover: browse categories, search the wall, or sort by all, trending, and top-rated ideas.
3. Discuss: vote ideas up or down, comment, reply, like comments, and receive realtime notifications.
4. Remix: fork someone else's idea into a new one while keeping a link to its origin, with a visible remix history.

Reading public ideas does not require an account. Publishing, voting, commenting, and remixing require signing in (email/password or Google).

## Categories

Technology, Business, Creative, Social Impact, Education, Health, Entertainment, and Environment, each with subcategories (for example Software & Apps, AI & Machine Learning, Startups, FinTech, Games, Design).

## Key pages

- [The idea wall](https://greatwallofideas.com/ideas): browse, search, and sort all public ideas.
- Individual ideas: https://greatwallofideas.com/ideas?id={idea-id} opens a single public idea with its description, votes, comments, and remix history.
- Search: https://greatwallofideas.com/ideas?q={search-term}
- [Sitemap](https://greatwallofideas.com/sitemap.xml): every public idea URL.

## Content and privacy

- Only ideas marked public are visible to visitors and listed in the sitemap; private ideas are visible only to their author.
- Ideas posted anonymously are shown with the author "Anonymous".

## Project

- Source code: https://github.com/jouleka/great-wall-of-ideas
- Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Supabase (Auth, PostgreSQL with row-level security, Realtime, Storage), deployed on Cloudflare via OpenNext.
